title: UEBA — Behavioral Baseline Analytics
description: UEBA Phase 1: Behavioral baseline analytics. All panels are advisory-only. No automated enforcement actions.

options.content: **Advisory Notice:** Behavioral analytics are advisory-only and explainable. No automatic enforcement is executed. All anomaly scores are investigation aids only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM entity_behavior_baselines
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM baseline_anomaly_scores WHERE scored_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM baseline_anomaly_scores WHERE scored_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND confidence >= 0.75
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM peer_group_profiles
SELECT count(DISTINCT entity_key) AS value FROM entity_behavior_baselines

panels.title: Anomaly Volume Over Time
panels.description: Count of advisory-only anomaly scores per hour. No enforcement action is triggered.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', scored_at) AS time, count(*) AS value FROM baseline_anomaly_scores WHERE scored_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT anomaly_type AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM baseline_anomaly_scores WHERE scored_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY anomaly_type ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Top Anomalous Users (Advisory)
panels.description: Users with most anomaly scores in last 7 days. Advisory-only — no automated action.

targets.rawSql: SELECT entity_key, count(*) AS anomaly_count, round(max(confidence)::numeric, 2) AS max_confidence, max(scored_at) AS last_anomaly FROM baseline_anomaly_scores WHERE entity_type = 'user' AND scored_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY entity_key ORDER BY anomaly_count DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top Anomalous Hosts (Advisory)
panels.description: Hosts with most anomaly scores in last 7 days. Advisory-only — no automated action.

targets.rawSql: SELECT entity_key, count(*) AS anomaly_count, round(max(confidence)::numeric, 2) AS max_confidence, max(scored_at) AS last_anomaly FROM baseline_anomaly_scores WHERE entity_type = 'host' AND scored_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY entity_key ORDER BY anomaly_count DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Abnormal Data Volume (bytes_out anomalies)
panels.description: Outbound data volume anomalies over time. Advisory-only — no blocking or enforcement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', scored_at) AS time, count(*) AS value FROM baseline_anomaly_scores WHERE anomaly_type = 'abnormal_bytes_out' AND scored_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Peer Group Deviation Trend
panels.description: Entities deviating from their peer group over time. Advisory-only — no automated enforcement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', scored_at) AS time, count(*) AS value FROM baseline_anomaly_scores WHERE anomaly_type = 'peer_group_behavior_deviation' AND scored_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Baseline Drift — High Variance Dimensions
panels.description: Baseline dimensions with highest standard deviation — investigation candidates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT entity_key, entity_type, dimension, round(baseline_mean::numeric, 3) AS mean, round(baseline_stddev::numeric, 3) AS stddev, sample_count, peer_group_key FROM entity_behavior_baselines WHERE baseline_stddev > 0 ORDER BY baseline_stddev DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: UEBA Risk Contribution by Factor
panels.description: Distribution of UEBA risk factor contributions. Advisory amplification only — no autonomous enforcement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE anomaly_type WHEN 'abnormal_bytes_out' THEN 'abnormal_data_volume_factor' WHEN 'unusual_login_time' THEN 'unusual_activity_time_factor' WHEN 'peer_group_behavior_deviation' THEN 'peer_deviation_factor' ELSE 'baseline_anomaly_factor' END AS factor, count(*) AS value FROM baseline_anomaly_scores WHERE confidence >= 0.75 AND scored_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT p.peer_group_key, p.group_label, p.group_type, p.entity_count, count(s.id) AS recent_deviations FROM peer_group_profiles p LEFT JOIN baseline_anomaly_scores s ON s.peer_group_key = p.peer_group_key AND s.scored_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY recent_deviations DESC LIMIT 15
